{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABZYBZ9w", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhC_X2M", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 29, "title": "Correct SCSP master-volume attenuation across PCM, DSP and CD-DA", "body": "## Problem

Related to #17.

At `35fde4bb8a4af78d7ce3b4f35695a4427d65649f`, `Scsp::push_output` in `src/sound.rs:469–481` clips the stereo mix, then multiplies it by `MVOL / 15`. Its comment explicitly describes a linear scale. Sega specifies a logarithmic master-volume control with nominal 3 dB steps.

For an unclipped input of 16384, the current expression produces 14199 at MVOL 13 and 1092 at MVOL 1. The documented attenuation implies approximately half amplitude at 13 and approximately 1/128 at 1. These are source-expression calculations, not results from a new emulator run. Both implementations agree at mute and full volume, so existing full-volume audio fixtures do not distinguish them.

This changes guest-programmed global volume and fade behavior across every sound source. Correcting the common output stage has broader benefit than adding another isolated synthesis effect.

## Expected outcome

Implement the documented MVOL attenuation staircase once in the shared SCSP output path. Direct slot audio, executing DSP output and CD-DA through EXTS must receive the same final attenuation, including when mixed together.

Primary hardware contract:

- [Sega sound FAQ, Overview, volume-settings question](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/faq/sound/p01_10.htm): MVOL advances in 3 dB steps and governs all slots, DSP output and CD-DA.
- [SCSP User’s Manual, chapter 1, CD-DA routing and MVOL](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/scsp/hon/p01_30.htm): zero mutes; F is unity.
- [ST-077-R2, §4.2 MIXER, printed pp.82–88, tables 4.27–4.31 and MVOL description](https://antime.kapsi.fi/sega/files/ST-077-R2-052594.pdf#page=94): source routing, final-stage placement and the requirement that lowering MVOL does not undo upstream clipping. Printed p.35 defines write-only reads.

Document the deterministic coefficient quantization and signed rounding policy. Sega uses nominal dB descriptions alongside binary amplitude conventions; distinguish that numerical modeling choice from measured chip coefficients. Establish independent expected values before implementing the gain calculation. Do not claim analog or bit-exact DAC conformance.

Scope is the shared MVOL behavior and its register, reset, sample-production and integration evidence. Envelope rates, unrelated mixer changes, 18-bit DAC operation and other sound timing gaps remain separate mandatory umbrella work. Agents may correct technical assumptions using affirmative primary evidence, documenting exact references and rationale in this Issue without human confirmation.

## Context and reproduction

Inspect `src/sound.rs:435–479`: DSP effects and external stereo inputs join the slot mix before the linear MVOL expression. Existing tests provide reusable execution and browser infrastructure:

- `src/sound/tests.rs:91–116` and `src/sound/dsp/tests.rs:207–239` validate source mixing at MVOL F.
- `tests/sound.rs` executes original SH-2/68k waveform computation and checks exact stereo samples.
- `tests/cdda.rs:24–79` executes guest CD commands and checks independently calculated CD-DA samples.
- `scripts/scsp-dma.mjs:43–57` demonstrates production AudioWorklet peak, underflow and drop assertions.

Add a focused regression that renders known positive and negative signals at intermediate MVOL settings. It must fail with the inherited linear expression and pass after correction. A helper-only comparison is insufficient.

No open Issues were returned by the planning-time repository query. The current main build remains in progress; it supplies neither success nor failure evidence. Existing recorded merges do not establish complete hardware conformance.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Record the primary-derived MVOL mapping for all sixteen settings, coefficient conversion, rounding and bounded numerical tolerance. Zero must mute exactly and F must preserve existing unity output. Independent intermediate vectors must reject `MVOL / 15`.
- [ ] Implement the attenuation in the common final output stage. Native source-path tests cover direct PCM, executing effects DSP, external stereo input and combined sources, including positive/negative samples, asymmetric channels, silence and clipping before attenuation. Expected values must not call production gain helpers or be captured from emulator output.
- [ ] Verify that mute changes output without stopping guest CPUs, voices, DSP execution, CD playback or sample generation. Restoring volume must expose continued source progress rather than restarting or replaying it.
- [ ] Preserve write-only register reads, byte-lane updates and MEM4MB state. Exercise actual SH-2 and 68k writes to MVOL, including low-byte updates. Check completed writes around sample-production boundaries, already queued audio and SCSP/cold reset. Traces must remain deterministic across advancement chunks 1/3/17/10000; document any unmeasured sub-sample latch convention separately.
- [ ] Supply an original permissively licensed, reproducible guest fixture using real SH-2/68k instructions, SCSP registers, an executing DSP program and generated mixed-track media. Native Machine execution must distinguish direct PCM, DSP and runtime CD-DA paths and compare source-authored stereo expectations at mute, unity and intermediate gains. Include changed waveform/coefficient/audio operands, an omitted volume-write control and repeated cold boots.
- [ ] Execute the same guest/media in rebuilt production Wasm under the existing headless browser workflow. Assert deterministic PCM amplitudes and production AudioWorklet delivery at distinguishing gains. Keep blocked/muted/underflow/drop states observable; host volume changes or manufactured audio cannot satisfy the guest MVOL checks.
- [ ] Demonstrate that restoring the inherited linear expression fails a new source-path test and a native guest amplitude assertion. Preserve existing exact full-volume vectors and all required Star Collector, Prism Courier, Hardware Lab, sound/DSP/CD-DA, input, backup, reset and privacy checks.
- [ ] Pass `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, native all-target and Wasm Clippy with warnings denied, fixture/media reproduction checks, `sh scripts/build-web.sh` and the complete extended `npm run test:browser` under `/saturn-rust/`, without required skips.
- [ ] Update the conformance matrix and validation record with precise implementation/spec/test references, reproducible artifact hashes, actual results and remaining deviations. This completes only this increment. Remaining CPU/peripheral, multiprocessor/bus/reset, SCU/DSP, video/audio, CD/media/HLE, SMPC and comprehensive integration requirements remain mandatory. Commercial-game compatibility remains unverified.

## Optional validation

None required. No personal firmware, commercial game, physical console, human listening/approval or live Pages inspection is needed.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
